newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary June PMI index 56.7 pct vs 53.3 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Hungary June PMI index 56.7 pct vs 53.3 pct in May.

text.p: Hungary's Purchasing Manager Index (PMI) was 56.7 percent in June, up from 53.3 percent in April, the Hungarian Association of Logistics, Purchasing and Inventory Management (HALPIM) said on Thursday. The following is a history of the index on a month-to-month basis:

NOTE: The PMI is calculated using the same methodology as the United States' National Association of Purchasing Management Index. A figure above 50 indicates increasing economic activity, while a number below 50 shows declining economic activity.
